name: AmeriGas Propane
notes: Researched from public amerigas.com and myamerigas.com pages only (no sign-in, no guest lookup). Sign-in is MyAmeriGas with Email Address + Password on one page; the forgot-password link is labelled Login Help. No MFA is described publicly, so the family default is kept. Auto Pay is a toggle under Billing & Payments > Payment Methods and processes on the invoice due date; the accepted Auto Pay method types are not published (family default kept). Closing an account is phone-only (1-888-495-7697, Moving Out page). Late charge is the GREATER of 1.5% of the average daily balance or $36.00 (Maryland differs). Credit-card surcharge varies by state and is capped at cost of acceptance (debit/ACH exempt), so no card fee is modelled. $3.99 paper invoice fee (waived with paperless; not in ME, NY, NJ, RI) is in help only. Integrated 2026-10-09: late charge modelled as the greater of 1.5% or $36.00 (billing.lateFeeMinCents). Independent review 2026-10-09: login page re-checked (Email Address, Password, Log In, Forgot password?, Login Help, Create Account, Guest Pay & Order); forgot/register/guest labels corrected to the visible wording. Pay steps now follow How To Pay My Bill (Payment Due / Pay By Invoice, Confirm Payment); paperless steps added (Billing Notifications toggle); Auto Pay turn-off is not described publicly, so the help now says the toggle is assumed. Fees re-checked on Fees and Rates ($36.00 / 1.5%, $33.00 returned payment, $3.99 paper invoice). Review 2026-10-09 (2): the inferred autopay_cancel note was removed from the capability because supported-capability notes render on the AutoPay page as if the biller said them; the inference is recorded here instead.

cancel_service.note: To close your AmeriGas account when moving out, call 1-888-495-7697. Accounts cannot be closed online.

help.title: How to pay your AmeriGas bill
paragraphs: Log in to MyAmeriGas, pick the account if you have more than one, and choose Make a Payment from your Account Summary. Choose Payment Due to pay the amount due (or pay ahead when nothing is due), or Pay By Invoice to pick specific invoices. Then set the payment date, use a saved payment method or add a new one, select Next, review and select Confirm Payment. You get an on-screen confirmation and an email.

You can also use Guest Pay & Order without logging in, pay by phone at any hour at 1-800-263-7442, or mail a check or money order with your account number to AmeriGas, PO Box 371473, Pittsburgh, PA 15250.
steps: Choose Make a Payment from Account Summary.
Pick Payment Due or Pay By Invoice.
Choose a date and payment method.

help.title: Enroll in Auto Pay
paragraphs: Auto Pay charges your chosen payment method on the day each invoice is due, so you do not need to log in or schedule payments. AmeriGas can text you a reminder a few days before an Auto Pay payment runs.

To enroll, log in to MyAmeriGas, open Payment Methods from the Billing & Payments menu, review or add a payment method, toggle Auto Pay on, choose the method, review the program details and select Confirm. To stop Auto Pay later, manage it from the same Payment Methods page or contact AmeriGas.
steps: Open Billing & Payments, then Payment Methods.
Review or add a payment method.
Turn the Auto Pay switch on and confirm the method.

help.title: Enroll in Paperless Billing
paragraphs: To go paperless, log in to MyAmeriGas, choose Billing Notifications from the Billing & Payments menu and switch on the paperless toggle in the Billing & Payment Email Notifications section, then check the email address used for billing notices. Invoices then arrive by email, and MyAmeriGas keeps up to two years of invoice history whether or not you are enrolled.
Customers who keep paper invoices pay a $3.99 paper invoice fee per invoice. Enrolling in Paperless Billing avoids it. The fee does not apply in Maine, New York, New Jersey or Rhode Island.
steps: Open Billing & Payments, then Billing Notifications.
In Billing & Payment Email Notifications, switch Paperless on.
Check the email address that will receive your invoices.

help.title: Fees and rates
paragraphs: Invoices not paid by the due date are charged a late charge of 1.5% of the average daily balance or $36.00, whichever is greater. Maryland customers have a different late charge.

Credit card payments may carry a surcharge no higher than AmeriGas's cost of acceptance; it never applies to debit cards, bank (ACH) payments or third-party payments, and some states prohibit or cap it.
A returned check or ACH payment costs $33.00 unless state law sets a lower amount. Paper invoices cost $3.99 each unless you go paperless (not charged in ME, NY, NJ or RI).

help.title: Payment plans
paragraphs: Pay Per Month (Convenience Pay) spreads your yearly propane cost over twelve monthly payments that are recalculated every three months. It requires a soft credit check.
Pay Per Delivery means you pay for each fill-up, either in advance (no credit check) or after delivery (soft credit check). Choose a plan when you get a quote or in MyAmeriGas.
AmeriGas generally accepts LIHEAP and other energy assistance payments; the agency must provide proof of assistance. Call 1-800-263-7442 to use assistance.

help.title: Moving out: closing your account
paragraphs: To close your AmeriGas account when you move out, call 1-888-495-7697. AmeriGas helps you settle any remaining balance and start the transfer to the new owner.
